patch.value: Preview Linear field ownership and same-field conflicts
Compare an explicitly acknowledged Linear field snapshot with complete SDK local reads and current provider observations. Read-only preview; no cross-system atomic guarantee.

Disjoint edits are distinguished from same-field conflicts; unknown bases never imply safe overwrites; preview makes zero mutations and explicitly declines atomic cross-system guarantees; typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, actionable refusals, docs, seeded model tests and public tracker validation.
